title: Key
description: Look up values using a saved key lookup model. Requires a WrangleWorks account and a model with purpose lookup and stored variant key. Missing or unknown variants are rejected; use lookup for legacy models.

recipe_writer.reason: Automatically documented from schema; execution eligibility requires review.

configuration_schema.description: Look up values using a saved key lookup model. Requires a WrangleWorks account and a model with purpose lookup and stored variant key. Missing or unknown variants are rejected; use lookup for legacy models.

input.description: One input column, optionally expressed as a single-item list.

model_id.description: Existing saved key lookup model ID, not a catalog ID.

output.description: Output column or columns; defaults to the input column. Named lookup columns return their values; other names receive match dictionaries. With n greater than one, n output columns or a wildcard name such as 'Match *' distribute match dictionaries across columns.

lookup_mode.description: Look up each row, each distinct input, or each matrix permutation. by_matrix requires matrix_variables in the forwarded options.

matrix_variables.description: Columns that define the permutations for by_matrix mode.

n.description: Optional number of matches using the existing lookup behavior. Supported only with by_row. When greater than one, a single output contains a list of match dictionaries unless expanded with a wildcard.
